verdict.first_step_1: Split the starter into two marked jars (feeding one with the new flour and the other with the old flour or whole wheat/rye at a 20:50:50 ratio) and record the hours until each peaks.
verdict.first_step_2: Inspect the starter for visible signs of death (such as fuzzy mold or pink/orange streaks) and confirm it was not heated above roughly 120°F.
verdict.reason: Reply 1 adheres to the facts by stating in plain words that timing does not prove causation and using a marked jar to monitor activity, whereas Reply 2 omits the causation distinction and directly contradicts the facts by telling the reader to skip the float test.
